title: Shredder
description: A glossy desk shredder drawn like an iOS 6 icon: brushed aluminium, a stitched leather band and a green glass button over a wire-mesh bin. Push Revolver, Abbey Road or Sgt. Pepper into the slot and it hums, pulls the sleeve through and drops sixteen strips that curl into a heap you can watch through the mesh.
intent: One paper mechanic in a flat, layered 2D object: the sleeve is sliced into real strips of the cover that hang, sway and fall, instead of a 3D simulation.
